seen: The death card says a stable character stays down until it gets healed; nothing mentions the hours.
fix: A note on the stable state: after 1d4 hours without healing the creature regains 1 hit point (master).

name: Knocking a creature out
says: An attacker may choose to knock a creature out instead of killing it when reducing it to 0 with a melee attack: it falls unconscious and stable.
does: No nonlethal option exists: an NPC at 0 is defeated, a player's character at 0 enters death saves; the master can discard the damage or edit hit points but cannot mark someone stable.
seen: Nothing.
fix: A nonlethal flag on the damage roll that leaves the target at 0, unconscious and stable.

name: Resistance and vulnerability order
says: Resistance and vulnerability apply after all other modifiers; resistance halves (rounded down), vulnerability doubles, immunity makes it 0.
does: Adjust takes flat reductions first, then immunity, then resistance, then vulnerability, per damage type; 25 fire with resistance and vulnerability lands 24; a nonmagical qualifier checks the attack's origin; the master can leave a source out.
seen: The master's log names the reason; a player reads the damage as rolled.

name: Multiple resistances count once
says: Multiple instances of resistance or vulnerability to the same damage type count as one.
does: covering collects the sources of each kind and applies one halving or doubling per type, listing all the sources (a race and a feature count once).
seen: The master's step names every source.

name: Mounting and dismounting
says: Once per move you can mount a willing creature within 5 ft or dismount, costing half your speed.
does: MountCombatant and DismountCombatant cost half the rider's speed on its surface (the Dash not counted), once per move, refused when speed is 0 or less movement is left; dismounting lands on a free neighbouring square.
seen: Mount and dismount buttons with their cost.

name: Mount size and willingness
says: A mount must be willing and at least one size larger than the rider with a suitable anatomy.
does: A Medium rider needs a Large mount; the master marks which NPCs and creatures are willing mounts (Montaria); the pony and the mastiff of Find Steed are too small.
seen: Refusal text on the mount button; the master's mark.

name: Controlled mount
says: A controlled mount acts as the rider directs, keeps pace with its initiative and can only Dash, Disengage and Dodge.
does: A controlled mount takes the rider's initiative and acts right after it in a joint turn; mountLimit refuses every action but those three; the rider's player moves it.
seen: Disabled options with "A montaria que leva alguém só pode usar Disparada, Desengajar ou Esquivar."

name: Independent mount
says: An independent mount keeps its own place in the initiative and acts as it wishes, carrying the rider.
does: An independent mount keeps its initiative and turn, the pair is one occupant of the mount's square, and the rider can be targeted separately from the mount.
seen: Two entries in the order; the link is shown to those who see both.

name: Mount moved against its will or rider knocked prone
says: If the mount is moved against its will, or the rider is knocked prone, the rider makes a DC 10 Dexterity save or falls prone within 5 ft.
does: RollMountSave opens a window for the rider's player (the master for an NPC): total at least 10 holds; a failure sets Prone and lands the rider on the nearest free square next to the mount; a rider at 0 hit points falls with no roll.
seen: Dexterity save prompt (DC shown only under the table rule) and the fall line.

name: Mount knocked prone or killed
says: If the mount is knocked prone or dies under its rider, the rider can use its reaction to land on its feet within 5 ft, otherwise it falls prone.
does: A reaction window for the rider opens when the mount is knocked prone or reaches 0 hit points; the rider spends its reaction to land on its feet or the pass throws it prone; a steed the caster dismisses lets the rider land with no window.
seen: Reaction window prompt for the rider.

name: Underwater melee attacks
says: A creature fighting underwater has disadvantage on melee attack rolls unless the weapon is a dagger, javelin, shortsword, spear or trident (or the creature has a swimming speed).
does: Water painted on the map changes only the movement cost; no attack mode source reads the surface.
seen: Nothing.
fix: A mode source for an attacker standing on a water square.

name: Underwater ranged attacks
says: A ranged weapon attack underwater automatically misses beyond normal range and has disadvantage within it, except a crossbow, a net or a thrown javelin, spear, trident or dart.
does: Nothing reads the surface for an attack; the table's modes ignore water.
seen: Nothing.
fix: Same mode source and a range refusal for attackers or targets in water.

says: A creature fully immersed in water has resistance to fire damage.
does: No resistance is added for a creature on a water square; the master may add it by hand.
seen: Nothing.
